title: Supply Chain Planning Internship (6 months)
description: Supply Chain Planning Internship (6 months) Drive Real Impact in Global Supply Chain Planning Curious about how planning decisions shape business performance and customer experience? This internship gives you the chance to dive deep into supply chain planning in a truly international environment. You will work side by side with experienced professionals, gaining hands-on exposure to data analysis, planning processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Your work will help improve visibility, coordination, and performance across the supply chain, supporting effective decision-making that impacts customers worldwide. If you have an analytical mindset, a structured approach, and a drive to learn, this opportunity will equip you with practical skills and insights for your future career in supply chain management. This role is offered onsite in our Resmed Amsterdam office located at Herikerbergweg 292-342, Amsterdam 1101 CT. What You’ll Do Support supply chain planning activities by helping maintain planning inputs, assumptions, and working files. Analyse supply chain data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring follow-up. Assist in preparing reports, dashboards, and summaries that provide visibility into planning performance and business priorities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support timely communication, alignment, and issue resolution. Help maintain accurate data in planning and business systems through regular checks and updates. Contribute to analysis and improvement activities that support more effective planning processes. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to standardise processes, reduce manual work, and improve visibility. Prepare clear presentations or decision-support materials for team discussions, reviews, and stakeholder updates. Learn and apply core supply chain planning concepts in a practical business environment. What You Bring Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s final year or Master’s programme in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Available for a 6-month non-thesis internship based in Amsterdam. Professional fluency in English Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to work with data and translate findings into clear insights. Comfortable using Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to Power BI, Tableau, Oracle, SAP, or other planning/data tools is a plus. Structured, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-moving supply chain environment. Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Interest in supply chain planning, inventory management, logistics, and process improvement. What Sets You Apart Analytical Curiosity: You dive into data and uncover patterns that inform better decisions. Structured Thinking: You organize complex information to drive clarity and action. Collaborative Mindset: You value teaming up with different experts to solve problems. Growth Orientation: You seek learning opportunities and embrace new challenges. Attention to Detail: You understand that accuracy underpins effective planning. Why Join Resmed At Resmed, we pioneer health technologies that improve quality of life for millions around the globe. You will join a multinational team committed to transforming care and enabling healthier living. This internship offers real-world experience, mentorship, and an inclusive environment where your ideas can make an impact, whether it’s optimizing supply chains or supporting innovations that help people sleep, breathe, and live better. #LI-EU Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. description:
Internship Eligibility Please note that we can only offer internships to students who are currently enrolled at a university or other recognized higher-education institution for the full duration of the internship. Your educational institution must be able to provide and sign an official internship/learning agreement between you, the institution, and SkyGeo. ————— About SkyGeo SkyGeo is a leading provider of satellite radar interferometry (InSAR) solutions. Our strength is not only producing millimeter-level deformation estimates, but diagnosing what the movements mean in the context of an asset, an operation, and the decisions teams need to make. We work with customers to incorporate site context and monitoring objectives, so the output is not just a sea of data. This approach reduces the risk of misinterpretation and helps organizations manage assets for the long term. The Internship We are continuously looking for motivated and curious students to join our Data Analytics team as interns. As an intern at SkyGeo, you will work on real-world applications of InSAR, supporting projects in fields such as: Infrastructure monitoring (railways, dikes, pipelines, buildings, bridges, tunnels, etc.) Energy assets (oil & gas, offshore wind, CO₂ storage/CCS, pipelines and related infrastructure) Mining operations (subsidence, slope stability, tailings facilities, asset monitoring) You will gain hands-on experience in processing and interpreting satellite data, developing innovative methodologies, and applying geospatial analysis to solve complex challenges.

Who we are looking for We welcome students with a background in: Geoscience, Geodesy, Remote Sensing, Civil Engineering, or related fields Strong analytical and quantitative skills Affinity with GIS, remote sensing, and programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB, R) Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn What we offer An opportunity to work with cutting-edge satellite data and technology Guidance and mentorship from experienced InSAR specialists A dynamic and international team environment Flexible internship periods (to fit study requirements) Possibility to link the internship to thesis research How to Apply We have four internship places available in 2027, with start dates spread throughout the year. Internships typically last 5 to 6 months. We’ll post regular updates on availability on our website. If you are interested, we are happy to receive your CV and a short motivation letter (including your preferred internship period). Join SkyGeo and contribute to understanding and monitoring our changing world – from space...
